objective: The evidence dialog has an accessible name, a single close path covering the button, Escape and cancel, and returns focus to whatever opened it.
decision_supported: Is the fallback open attribute a modal? No, so focus must be moved and returned explicitly rather than relying on the platform.
acceptance: The dialog is named by its title and described by its metadata.
Escape, cancel and the close button all run one close path.
Focus returns to the element that opened the dialog.
stop_conditions: The change would need a browser-only test harness.
risks_and_fallbacks: Moving focus on open could fight a native dialog that already does it; the close button is a stable target either way.
